readme.1_extract_the_complete_halo_meist: 1. Extract the complete Halo Meister release ZIP and run HaloMeister.exe from that folder.
readme.2_close_campaign_evolved_open_set: 2. Close Campaign Evolved, open Setup, and select the folder containing the game.
readme.3_select_install_or_repair_update: 3. Select Install or Repair / update. Halo Meister installs the bundled pinned UE4SS build, verifies it, applies the supported settings and signatures, and installs the Halo Meister bridge. Replaced files are backed up. No download is required.
readme.4_start_campaign_evolved_load_an_: 4. Start Campaign Evolved, load an offline campaign mission, and select Connect in Halo Meister. Reconnect whenever the game restarts.
readme.5_open_a_live_tools_page_and_refr: 5. Open a Live tools page and refresh or scan. Only tags and objects loaded by the current mission can be shown.
readme.a_configuration_is_a_focused_patc: A configuration is a focused patch set, not a dump of every live tag. Raw-byte writes are excluded because process addresses and relocated offsets are session-specific. Build native mod is the separate workflow for creating a persistent _P.utoc/.ucas/.pak overlay.
readme.back_up_make_one_focused_change_v: Back up → make one focused change → verify it → test offline → restore or keep it.
readme.close_campaign_evolved_halo_meist: Close Campaign Evolved. Halo Meister blocks local settings and save restores while the game may overwrite or lock those files.
readme.close_the_game_open_setup_run_rep: Close the game, open Setup, run Repair / update, and restart Campaign Evolved. Connecting to the process and installing the bridge are separate requirements; some tools need both.
readme.haloscript_submissions_are_not_ve: HaloScript submissions are not verified: the console API does not return evaluation output, so confirm the result in game. A catalog entry can be mission-specific, unavailable in the current scenario, or unsafe with unsuitable arguments. Use scripting only in an offline campaign and save important progress first.
readme.if_a_live_experiment_behaves_badl: If a live experiment behaves badly, stop the affected action and restart the game. For persistent changes, restore the relevant snapshot or backup. Never force an action after build verification fails.
readme.insert_selected_creates_an_editab: Insert selected creates an editable expression. Full reference opens the complete extracted function and global catalog.
readme.load_an_offline_mission_reconnect: Load an offline mission, reconnect, and scan again. Halo Meister can only list data resident in the current mission.
readme.open_advanced_scripting_haloscrip: Open Advanced → Scripting. HaloScript is selected by default and runs through the game's console bridge; Lua remains available from the language picker.
readme.open_phone_remote_enable_the_loca: Open Phone remote, enable the local server, and use the pairing link or QR code on a trusted device. Configure the firewall only when needed, use private networks or Tailscale, and never port-forward the remote.
readme.open_progress_profile_authenticat: Open Progress & profile, authenticate with PlayFab, and download your current save. Retail builds are intentionally read-only: you can inspect campaign progress, profile data, and entitlements without uploading changes.
readme.open_setup_while_the_game_is_clos: Open Setup while the game is closed, install or repair the bridge, then restart the game. Load an offline campaign mission, select Connect, and choose a tool under Live tools. Most live changes reset when the mission unloads or the game restarts.
readme.press_ctrl_space_to_show_common_c: Press Ctrl+Space to show common commands at any time. The reference pane supports broader searches by function name, signature, or argument type.
readme.realtime_tags_can_keep_several_lo: Realtime tags can keep several loaded tags open in tabs for quick comparison. Selecting the same tag focuses its existing tab instead of opening a duplicate.
readme.schema_field_and_tag_reference_ed: Schema-field and tag-reference edits made in Halo Meister accumulate as a portable change set. Save configuration writes those changes to an editable .hmtagmod file; after scanning a compatible mission, Load configuration resolves the tag paths and nested blocks, applies the values, verifies every write, and rolls back earlier writes if the operation fails.
readme.select_authenticate_and_let_campa: Select Authenticate and let Campaign Evolved make a fresh PlayFab request. Session tickets are kept in Windows Credential Locker and are never shown as plaintext.
readme.start_campaign_evolved_enter_a_ca: Start Campaign Evolved, enter a campaign mission, then select Connect. If the game updated, a build lock may deliberately stop unsupported native tools.
readme.start_here_when_you_are_setting_u: Start here when you are setting up Halo Meister, choosing a workflow, or recovering from an experiment.
readme.type_two_or_more_command_characte: Type two or more command characters to open completions. Use ↑/↓ to choose, Tab or Enter to accept, and Esc to dismiss.
readme.use_game_files_for_equipped_custo: Use Game files for equipped customization, Meteorite settings, and Windows Gaming Services checkpoint backups. Retail customization always allows the base Mark VI armor and game-default appearances, but requires a matching loaded PlayFab entitlement for promotional armor and weapon skins. Choices whose store license cannot be verified are unavailable so Halo Meister does not bypass cosmetic ownership. Close the game before saving or restoring so it cannot overwrite the change.
readme.use_live_tools_only_in_an_offline: Use live tools only in an offline campaign. Close Campaign Evolved before changing local settings, restoring game saves, or installing the live-tools bridge. Keep your own known-good backups.
readme.use_one_expression_or_command_per: Use one expression or command per line. Halo Meister normalizes command-style and parenthesized input before handing it to the game.
